objective: Diagnose the retained Roots strict coffee-product-semantics failure without a live request or authority promotion.

product_name.basis: The normalizer would have listed product_name in the failure reason if it were absent, but the withheld path retained neither its sanitized value nor extraction path.

attributable_displayed_price.basis: The failure reason omitted attributable_displayed_price, but the withheld path retained neither the sanitized value nor extraction path.

canonical_identity.basis: The same-host canonical URL and non-empty house-blend-coffee slug are retained explicitly.

coffee_product_semantics.basis: The matcher uses Product JSON-LD, explicit coffee-bean text, or a coffee name plus labeled attributes, but ignores the retained official /products/ route and coffee-bearing canonical slug.

retail_product_not_cafe_menu.basis: The normalizer did not emit the menu-only failure and the retained canonical is a /products/ route, but raw visible text was intentionally not retained.

semantic_witness_diagnosis.explanation: The sanitized structured subset contains only an empty offer and no retained Product type or name.
The composite gate failed, but the exact sanitized name and visible lexical candidates were not retained.
The retained labeled-field subset is empty and the exact sanitized product name was not retained.
The retained same-host canonical path is /products/house-blend-coffee, but the current semantic matcher has no canonical-route witness.

smallest_semantic_correction.description: Add one high-confidence coffee semantic witness when the already-required name and attributable price are present and the same-host canonical path is an official /products/ route whose slug contains an explicit coffee token.

independent_retention_hardening.description: For future withheld normalization, retain sanitized candidate field values and extraction paths for every gate evaluated before the record decision.

required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.purpose: Positive official product route with a coffee-bearing slug, sanitized name and price, no Product JSON-LD, and no labeled coffee attributes.
required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.expected: semantic witness passes while every existing identity, price, canonical, menu, and provenance gate remains required

required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.purpose: Negative official product route with a non-coffee slug and no other coffee witness.
Negative menu/drink route containing a coffee token and price.
required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.expected: menu-only gate still withholds the record

required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.purpose: Negative coffee-bearing product slug with missing product name or attributable price.
required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.expected: missing strict identity or price still withholds the record

required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.purpose: Withheld normalization retains only sanitized candidate values, extraction paths, and semantic decisions.
required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.expected: diagnosis is replayable without raw HTML, headers, cookies, credentials, or session material

required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.purpose: Existing Roots and Nana fixtures plus the durable exit-2 artifact remain unchanged.
required_offline_tests_and_fixtures.expected: no historical reinterpretation and no frozen regression

next_step.recommendation: Implement the two offline-only parser and diagnostic-retention changes with RSD-F01 through RSD-F06, then request independent review before considering any separately authorized live validation.
